comment: * This class stores the SIM PIN for automatic verification after an unattended reboot.

variables.name: TIMER_VALUE_AFTER_OTA_MILLIS
variables.comment:
* Time duration in milliseconds to allow automatic PIN verification after reboot. All unused
     * PINs are discarded when the timer expires.

variables.name: TIMER_VALUE_BEFORE_OTA_MILLIS
MIN_ICCID_LENGTH
variables.comment: Minimum valid length of the ICCID.

variables.name: MIN_PIN_LENGTH
variables.comment: Minimum length of the SIM PIN, as per 3GPP TS 31.101.

variables.name: MAX_PIN_LENGTH
variables.comment: Maximum length of the SIM PIN, as per 3GPP TS 31.101.

variables.name: ANDROID_KEY_STORE_PROVIDER
variables.comment: Variables related to the encryption of the SIM PIN.

variables.name: KEYSTORE_ALIAS_LONG_TERM_ALWAYS
variables.comment: Alias of the long-term key that does not require user authentication.

variables.name: KEYSTORE_ALIAS_LONG_TERM_USER_AUTH
variables.comment: Alias of the user authentication blound long-term key.

variables.name: KEYSTORE_ALIAS_SHORT_TERM
variables.comment: Alias of the short-term key (30 minutes) used before and after an unattended reboot.

variables.name: SHARED_PREFS_NAME
variables.comment: - "reboot" is for the PIN(s) in other states and uses a short-term key (30 minutes)

variables.name: mShortTermSecretKeyDurationMinutes
variables.comment: Duration of the short-term key, in minutes.

variables.name: mRamStorage
variables.comment: RAM storage is used on secure devices before the device is unlocked.

methods.name: public synchronized void storePin(String pin, int slotId)
methods.comment: Store the {@code pin} for the {@code slotId}.

methods.name: public synchronized void clearPin(int slotId)
methods.comment: Clear the cached pin for the {@code slotId}.

methods.name: public synchronized String getPin(int slotId, String iccid)
methods.comment:
* Return the cached pin for the SIM card identified by {@code slotId} and {@code iccid}, or
     * an empty string if it is not available.
     *
     * The method returns the PIN only if the state is VERIFICATION_READY. If the PIN is found,
     * its state changes to AVAILABLE, so that it cannot be retrieved a second time during the
     * same boot cycle. If the PIN verification fails, it will be removed after the failed attempt.

methods.name: public synchronized int prepareUnattendedReboot(WorkSource workSource)
methods.comment:
* Prepare for an unattended reboot.
     *
     * All PINs in AVAILABLE and VERIFICATION_READY state are moved to REBOOT_READY state. A
     * timer is started to make sure that reboot occurs shortly after invoking this method.
     *
     * @return The result of the reboot preparation.

methods.name: private synchronized void onUserUnlocked()
methods.comment:
* Execute logic when a secure device is unlocked.
     *
     * The temporary long-term key that does not require user verification is replaced by the long
     * term key that requires user verification. The cached PIN temporarily stored in RAM are
     * merged with those on disk from the previous boot.

methods.name: private void onDeviceReady()
methods.comment:
* Executes logic when module is fully ready. This occurs immediately if the device is not
     * secure or after the user unlocks the device.
     *
     * At this point, the short-term key is initialized (if present), the configuration is read
     * and the status of each PIN is updated as needed.

methods.name: private synchronized void onTimerExpiration()
methods.comment:
* Executes logic at the expiration of the timer. This method is common for two cases:
     *  - timer started after unattended reeboot to verify the SIM PIN automatically
     *  - timer started after prepareUnattendedReboot() is invoked.

methods.name: private synchronized void onSimStatusChange(int slotId, @SimState int state)
methods.comment: Handle the update of the {@code state} of the SIM card in {@code slotId}.

methods.name: private void onSupplyPinComplete(int slotId, boolean success)
private boolean isDeviceSecure()
methods.comment: Return if the device is secure (device PIN is enabled).

methods.name: private boolean isDeviceLocked()
methods.comment: Return if the device is locked (device PIN is enabled and not verified).

methods.name: private SparseArray<StoredPin> loadPinInformation()
methods.comment: Loads the stored PIN informations for all SIM slots.

methods.name: private StoredPin loadPinInformation(int slotId)
methods.comment:
* Loads the stored PIN information for the {@code slotId}.
     *
     * The RAM storage is used if the device is locked, the disk storage is used otherwise.
     * This method tries to use both the long-term key and the short-term key (if available)
     * to retrieve the PIN information, regardless of its status.
     *
     * @return the stored {@code StoredPin}, or null if not present.

methods.name: private StoredPin loadPinInformationFromDisk(int slotId, String key, @Nullable SecretKey secretKey)
methods.comment:
* Load the PIN information from a specific file in non-volatile memory.
     *
     * @param key the key in the {@code SharedPreferences} to read
     * @param secretKey the key used for encryption/decryption
     * @return the {@code StoredPin} from non-volatile memory. It returns a default instance in
     * case of error.

methods.name: private StoredPin decryptStoredPin(byte[] blob, @Nullable SecretKey secretKey)
methods.comment:
Load the PIN information from an encrypted binary blob.
     *
     * @param blob the encrypted binary blob
     * @param secretKey the key used for encryption/decryption
     * @return the decrypted {@code StoredPin}, or null in case of error.

methods.name: private boolean savePinInformation(int slotId, @Nullable StoredPin storedPin)
methods.comment:
* Stores the PIN information.
     *
     * If the device is locked, the PIN information is stored to RAM, othewrwise to disk.
     * The PIN information is divided based on the PIN status and stored in two separate
     * files in non-volatile memory, each encrypted with a different key.
     *
     * @param slotId the slot ID
     * @param storedPin the PIN information to be stored
     * @return true if the operation was successfully done, false otherwise.

methods.name: private boolean savePinInformation(SharedPreferences.Editor editor, int slotId, StoredPin storedPin, String baseKey, SecretKey secretKey)
methods.comment:
* Store the PIN information to a specific file in non-volatile memory.
     *
     * @param editor the {@code SharedPreferences.Editor} to use for storage
     * @param slotId the slot ID
     * @param storedPin the PIN information to store
     * @param baseKey the base name of the key in the {@code SharedPreferences}. The full name is
     *        derived appending the value of {@code slotId}.
     * @param secretKey the key used for encryption/decryption
     * @return true if the operation was successful, false otherwise

methods.name: private boolean savePinInformationToRam(int slotId, @Nullable StoredPin storedPin)
methods.comment: Stored PIN information for slot {@code slotId} in RAM.

methods.name: private void cleanRamStorage()
methods.comment: Erases all the PINs stored in RAM before a secure device is unlocked.

methods.name: private void cleanRamStorage(int slotId)
methods.comment: Erases the PIN of slot {@code slotId} stored in RAM before a secure device is unlocked.

methods.name: private void verifyPendingPins()
methods.comment:
* Verifies all pending PIN codes that are ready for verification.
     *
     * The PIN verificartion is done if the PIN state is VERIFICATION_READY and the SIM
     * card has the PIN enabled and not verified.

methods.name: private void verifyPendingPin(int slotId)
methods.comment: Verifies the PIN code for a given SIM card in slot {@code slotId}.

methods.name: private int getBootCount()
methods.comment: Returns the boot count.

methods.name: private int getSlotCount()
methods.comment: Returns the number of available SIM slots.

methods.name: private int saveNumberOfCachedPins(int storedCount)
methods.comment:
* Saves the number of cached PINs ready for verification after reboot and returns the
     * previous value.

methods.name: private String getIccid(int slotId)
methods.comment: Returns the ICCID of the SIM card for the given {@code slotId}.

methods.name: private boolean isPinState(int slotId, PinState pinState)
methods.comment: Checks if the PIN status of the SIM in slot {@code slotId} is a given {@code PinState}.

methods.name: private boolean isCacheAllowed(int slotId)
methods.comment: Returns if the PIN cache is allowed for a given slot.

methods.name: private boolean isCacheAllowedByDevice()
methods.comment: Returns if the PIN cache is allowed by the device.

methods.name: private boolean isCacheAllowedByCarrier(int slotId)
methods.comment: Returns if the PIN cache is allowed by carrier for a given slot.

     * @return the created {@link SecretKey}, or null in case of error

methods.comment: Returns the validity end of a new short-lived key, or null if key does not expire.
